summary: Frontend-only UI redesign test (Sapien/SparkEdit-style docked layout). All 7 state scenarios from the review request were exercised against the Vite dev server with the dev-mock. Welcome screen, menu bar + toolbar always-visible-with-disabled-state behavior, open-map flow, 3-pane layout (Hierarchy / tabbed Center workspace / Properties Palette), 3D Viewport tab placeholder, tag group expand + row focus -> Properties Palette population + update (no stacking), checkbox independence (does not change palette focus, extract count updates), menu dropdowns (File/Tools/Help with About), dropdown switch/close behavior, Log Console entries after Extract, and status bar fields all verified. Zero browser console errors observed throughout.

integration_issues.flow: Tools menu disabled-state parity with toolbar
integration_issues.issue: After loading the (uncompressed) mock map, the toolbar's Decompress button is correctly disabled, but the Tools menu's 'Decompress Map' item (data-testid=menu-item-tools-decompress-map) is NOT disabled. The spec explicitly says menu items should mirror the toolbar's disabled states. All 4 Tools menu items show disabled=False while toolbar shows decompress-button-toolbar disabled=True. Likely cause: MenuBar.tsx not reading the same isCompressed/mapLoaded state as Toolbar.tsx when computing per-item disabled props.

action_items: Sync Tools menu item disabled states with the toolbar: menu-item-tools-decompress-map must be disabled when the loaded map is already decompressed (and when no map is open); same mapping for recompress/extract/inject when no map is open.
critical_code_review_comments: MenuBar and Toolbar duplicate the enable/disable logic for the same four actions; consider extracting a single useToolActionsAvailability() hook or passing a shared actions-availability object so the two surfaces cannot drift (which is exactly the bug seen).

ViewportPlaceholder, PropertiesPalette empty-state, and 'coming in later milestone' strings are repeated in several components - consolidating into a small constants module would reduce drift as M2-M4 land.
seed_data_creation: None - uses existing dev-mock.ts (10 tags across 10 class groups)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Vite dev server runs on :5173 (supervisor-free, started with npx vite). All new data-testids from the Sapien/SparkEdit redesign are present and functional. The dev-mock bloodgulch has exactly 10 tags, 1 per class group - normal. properties-palette-content correctly REPLACES (not stacks) when switching tag focus. Checkbox stopPropagation works. Only remaining discrepancy is menu/toolbar disabled-state parity in Tools menu.
